name: Independence
overview: Scripture reveals that true independence is rooted in the freedom Christ provides, calling believers to stand firm in this liberty and reject bondage (Galatians 5:1). While earthly authorities exist by God's ordination and require submission (Romans 13:1), our ultimate pursuit is spiritual maturity and unity in the knowledge of Christ (Ephesians 4:13). This journey toward Christlikeness is ongoing, marked by perseverance and reliance on His grace rather than self-attainment (Philippians 3:12). God's righteous goodness sustains and disciplines His people, underscoring that genuine freedom flows from His sovereign hand (Psalms 45:7; Romans 11:22).
